title: Choose Meals (response)
description: What subscriptions sends back. Part of this contract, not a separate message: the client renders the locked week straight from it.

subscriptionId.description: Echoes the request, so a client can match a late reply to its call.

recipeIds.description: What is locked in, which after the cutoff is the default meals rather than what was asked for.

cutoffAt.description: When this week stops accepting changes; the client shows it so a household knows how long it has.
